blocks.zh: 第8-10節：運作、績效評估與改善
blocks.en: Clauses 8-10: Operation, Performance Evaluation and Improvement

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Clause 8 運作控制的完整結構：從客戶需求確認、設計開發、外部供應商管控，到生產放行與不合格品處置
blocks.en: Understand the full structure of Clause 8 operational control: from confirming customer requirements, design and development and control of external providers, through to production release and handling of nonconforming outputs

blocks.zh: 區分設計審查（Review）、驗證（Verification）與確效（Validation）的不同目的，並對應藥廠實務
blocks.en: Distinguish the different purposes of design review, verification and validation, and map them to pharmaceutical practice

blocks.zh: 掌握 Clause 9 績效評估三個工具：監測量測、內部稽核、管理審查，及其在法規查廠準備中的意義
blocks.en: Master the three performance evaluation tools of Clause 9 (monitoring and measurement, internal audit, management review) and what they mean for regulatory inspection readiness

blocks.zh: 理解 Clause 10 改善機制中，矯正（Correction）與矯正措施（Corrective Action）的根本區別——CAPA 在 FDA/EMA 查廠中的核心地位
blocks.en: Understand the fundamental difference between correction and corrective action in the Clause 10 improvement mechanism, and the central role of CAPA in FDA/EMA inspections

blocks.zh: 比較 ISO 9001 要求與藥廠 GMP（ICH Q10、ISO 15378、QS Reg）在供應商管控、特殊製程確效、CAPA 等面向的深度差異
blocks.en: Compare ISO 9001 requirements with pharmaceutical GMP (ICH Q10, ISO 15378, QS Reg) in depth, in areas such as supplier control, special process validation and CAPA

blocks.zh: Operational Planning and Control — 運作規劃與控制
blocks.en: Operational Planning and Control

blocks.zh: 解說：運作規劃是 Clause 6 計畫的執行層
blocks.en: Commentary: Operational Planning Is the Execution Layer of Clause 6 Planning

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：計畫 → 執行 → 文件化
blocks.en: Core logic: plan, execute, document

blocks.zh: 8.1 是 ISO 9001 的「執行引擎」。Clause 6 決定了要做什麼（風險/機會計畫），8.1 規定了如何把這些計畫落地成受控的製程操作。
blocks.en: 8.1 is the "execution engine" of ISO 9001. Clause 6 decides what needs to be done (the risk/opportunity plan); 8.1 specifies how to turn those plans into controlled process operations.

blocks.zh: 準則（Criteria）：製程接受準則，等同藥廠的製程規格與 in-process control 限值
blocks.en: Criteria: process acceptance criteria, equivalent to a pharmaceutical plant's process specifications and in-process control limits

blocks.zh: 文件化資訊（Documented information）：批次紀錄、製程規程——藥廠已遠超此要求
blocks.en: Documented information: batch records and process procedures; pharmaceutical plants already go far beyond this requirement

blocks.zh: 計畫性變更控制：正式的 Change Control 系統——GMP 必備，ISO 9001 僅要求「控制並審查後果」
blocks.en: Control of planned changes: a formal Change Control system is a must in GMP, whereas ISO 9001 only requires that the consequences be "controlled and reviewed"

blocks.zh: 類比：蓋房子的施工圖
blocks.en: Analogy: construction drawings for a building

blocks.zh: Clause 6 是建築師的設計方案（決定要建什麼），8.1 是施工圖加上品質管理計畫（告訴工人每道工序的標準和驗收條件）。沒有施工圖，工人再努力也可能蓋錯。
blocks.en: Clause 6 is the architect's design concept (deciding what to build); 8.1 is the construction drawings plus the quality management plan (telling the workers the standard and acceptance conditions for every step). Without drawings, even hardworking builders can build the wrong thing.

blocks.zh: 藥廠視角：外包製程的控制
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical perspective: control of outsourced processes

blocks.zh: 「外包製程應受控制」（見 8.4）——在製藥 CDMO 中，每一個委外的檢驗、滅菌、包裝步驟都屬此範疇。ISO 9001 要求「控制」，GMP 則進一步要求正式的技術協議（Technical Agreement）與供應商稽核。
blocks.en: "Outsourced processes shall be controlled" (see 8.4): in a pharmaceutical CDMO, every outsourced testing, sterilization or packaging step falls under this. ISO 9001 requires "control"; GMP goes further and requires a formal Technical Agreement and supplier audits.

blocks.zh: Requirements for Products and Services — 產品與服務要求
blocks.en: Requirements for Products and Services

blocks.zh: 解說：合約審查——CDMO 的核心能力
blocks.en: Commentary: Contract Review, a Core Capability of a CDMO

blocks.zh: 8.2.1 客戶溝通的 5 個面向
blocks.en: The 5 aspects of customer communication in 8.2.1

blocks.zh: ① 產品資訊提供：規格書、CoA、SDS
blocks.en: (1) Providing product information: specifications, CoA, SDS

blocks.zh: ② 詢價/合約/訂單處理：含變更管理
blocks.en: (2) Handling enquiries, contracts and orders: including change management

blocks.zh: ③ 客戶回饋與投訴：ISO 要求收集，GMP 要求 CAPA
blocks.en: (3) Customer feedback and complaints: ISO requires collecting them; GMP requires CAPA

blocks.zh: ④ 客戶財產管理：客戶提供的原料、模具、IP
blocks.en: (4) Handling customer property: customer-supplied materials, tooling and IP

blocks.zh: ⑤ 應急措施要求：供應鏈中斷應對計畫
blocks.en: (5) Contingency action requirements: plans for responding to supply chain disruption

blocks.zh: 類比：餐廳點餐的確認流程
blocks.en: Analogy: confirming an order at a restaurant

blocks.zh: 8.2.3 合約審查就像廚師接到特殊菜單前先確認：食材有沒有（資源）、廚師會不會做（能力）、客人有沒有過敏（法規/隱含需求）。先確認，再承諾，才不會在出菜時出狀況。
blocks.en: 8.2.3 contract review is like a chef confirming a special order before accepting it: are the ingredients available (resources), can the chef cook it (capability), does the guest have allergies (regulatory/implied requirements)? Confirm first, then commit, so that nothing goes wrong when the dish is served.

blocks.zh: 藥廠 CDMO 的合約審查（8.2.3）
blocks.en: Contract review (8.2.3) in a pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 在接受新客戶委託前，合約審查要涵蓋：
blocks.en: Before accepting a new client's project, a CDMO's contract review must cover:

blocks.zh: 法規市場要求（FDA/EMA/PMDA 哪個市場？）
blocks.en: Regulatory market requirements (FDA, EMA or PMDA: which market?)

blocks.zh: 技術可行性（劑型、製程能力、無菌等級）
blocks.en: Technical feasibility (dosage form, process capability, sterility grade)

blocks.zh: 隱含要求（例：無菌產品自帶 Annex 1 要求，即使客戶未明確指定）
blocks.en: Implied requirements (e.g. a sterile product brings the Annex 1 requirements with it, even if the customer does not specify them)

blocks.zh: 技術協議（Quality Agreement）內容
blocks.en: Content of the Technical Agreement (Quality Agreement)

blocks.zh: 這正是 8.2.2b 所說的「組織需確認自己能兌現承諾」。
blocks.en: This is exactly what 8.2.2b means by "the organization can meet the claims for the products and services it offers".

blocks.zh: Design and Development — 設計與開發
blocks.en: Design and Development

blocks.zh: 解說：設計開發在製藥的對應
blocks.en: Commentary: How Design and Development Maps to Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: Review / Verification / Validation 三者的根本區別
blocks.en: The fundamental difference between Review, Verification and Validation

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的 NOTE 特別強調三者目的不同，這在藥廠環境中尤為重要：
blocks.en: The NOTE in ISO 9001 stresses that the three have different purposes, which matters especially in a pharmaceutical environment:

blocks.zh: Review（審查）：評估設計結果「能否達到要求」——設計審查會議（Design Review Meeting），藥廠比照 ICH Q8 中的配方設計審查
blocks.en: Review: evaluating whether the design results can "meet the requirements", as in a Design Review Meeting; pharmaceutical plants run the equivalent as the formulation design review under ICH Q8

blocks.zh: Verification（驗證）：確認「輸出符合輸入規格」——例如確認處方設計符合 TPP（Target Product Profile）中的規格要求
blocks.en: Verification: confirming that the "outputs meet the input specifications", e.g. confirming that the formulation design meets the specifications in the Target Product Profile (TPP)

blocks.zh: Validation（確效）：確認產品在「實際使用條件下」能達到預期用途——藥廠的製程確效（Process Validation）、清潔確效、滅菌確效
blocks.en: Validation: confirming that the product can achieve its intended use under "actual conditions of use": in pharmaceutical plants this means process validation, cleaning validation and sterilization validation

blocks.zh: 類比：設計一架飛機
blocks.en: Analogy: designing an aircraft

blocks.zh:
Review：工程師開會審查設計圖，確認翼展計算沒有錯誤。
Verification：在風洞中測試模型，確認氣動數據符合設計規格。
Validation：實機飛行測試，確認飛機在真實天空中能安全飛行。
blocks.en:
Review: engineers meet to review the design drawings and confirm that the wingspan calculations are correct.
Verification: a model is tested in a wind tunnel to confirm that the aerodynamic data meet the design specifications.
Validation: flight tests on the real aircraft confirm that it can fly safely in real skies.

blocks.zh: 三步缺一不可——風洞通過了，不代表真機飛得起來。
blocks.en: None of the three steps can be skipped: passing the wind tunnel does not mean the real aircraft will fly.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的設計開發對應關係
blocks.en: How design and development maps to pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: 8.3 設計開發 → ICH Q8 藥品開發（pharmaceutical development）
blocks.en: 8.3 Design and development → ICH Q8 pharmaceutical development

blocks.zh: 設計輸入（8.3.3） → Target Product Profile（TPP）、法規要求、前期研究數據
blocks.en: Design inputs (8.3.3) → Target Product Profile (TPP), regulatory requirements, early-stage study data

blocks.zh: 設計輸出（8.3.5） → 批次製造記錄（BMR）、品管方法、規格書
blocks.en: Design outputs (8.3.5) → batch manufacturing record (BMR), QC methods, specifications

blocks.zh: 設計變更（8.3.6） → 技術轉移後的 Post-Approval Change（變更管理）
blocks.en: Design changes (8.3.6) → post-approval changes after technology transfer (change management)

blocks.zh: 設計開發 → 生產：技術轉移（Technology Transfer）= 從 R&D 到商業生產
blocks.en: Design and development to production: Technology Transfer = moving from R&D to commercial production

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 Quality by Design（QbD）與 8.3 的連結
blocks.en: Linking ICH Q8 Quality by Design (QbD) with 8.3

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 提倡從設計初期就系統性地理解產品和製程，建立 Design Space。這正是 ISO 9001 8.3 設計控制的進階版：
blocks.en: ICH Q8 promotes a systematic understanding of the product and process from the earliest stage of design, and establishing a Design Space. This is the advanced version of the design controls in ISO 9001 8.3:

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）= 設計輸入
blocks.en: CQA (critical quality attributes) = design inputs

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）= 設計輸出的一部分
blocks.en: CPP (critical process parameters) = part of the design outputs

blocks.zh: Design Space = 驗證過的操作範圍
blocks.en: Design Space = the validated operating range

blocks.zh: Control of Externally Provided Processes, Products and Services — 外部供應管控
blocks.en: Control of Externally Provided Processes, Products and Services

blocks.zh: 解說：供應商管控——ISO 9001 vs. GMP
blocks.en: Commentary: Supplier Control, ISO 9001 vs. GMP

blocks.zh: 8.4.1 的三種情境
blocks.en: The three situations in 8.4.1

blocks.zh: 情境 A（納入自有產品）：採購原料 API、輔料、包材——典型的藥廠採購場景
blocks.en: Situation A (incorporated into your own products): purchasing API, excipients and packaging materials, the typical purchasing scenario in a pharmaceutical plant

blocks.zh: 情境 B（代表你直接交貨給客戶）：分銷商代替你出貨——藥廠較少但合約研究中存在
blocks.en: Situation B (delivered directly to the customer on your behalf): a distributor ships in your place; less common in pharmaceutical plants but found in contract research

blocks.zh: 情境 C（委外製程）：委託滅菌、委託檢驗、委託包裝——CDMO 的核心業務模式
blocks.en: Situation C (outsourced processes): outsourced sterilization, testing or packaging, which is the core business model of a CDMO

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 與 GMP 的供應商管控深度差異
blocks.en: The difference in depth of supplier control between ISO 9001 and GMP

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求「評估、選擇、監測、再評估」，但沒有規定如何做。GMP 標準走得更遠：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires "evaluation, selection, monitoring and re-evaluation" but does not prescribe how. GMP standards go further:

blocks.zh: ICH Q10：要求書面的供應商品質協議（Technical/Quality Agreement）
blocks.en: ICH Q10: requires written supplier quality agreements (Technical/Quality Agreement)

blocks.zh: ISO 15378（藥品包材）：供應商稽核計畫、定期評估報告
blocks.en: ISO 15378 (primary packaging materials for medicinal products): supplier audit programme and periodic evaluation reports

blocks.zh: FDA QS Regulation（21 CFR 820）：要求正式的 Approved Supplier List 與稽核紀錄
blocks.en: FDA QS Regulation (21 CFR 820): requires a formal Approved Supplier List and audit records

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 8：原料採樣與抽驗——到廠前的確認
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 8: sampling and testing of starting materials, i.e. confirmation before they arrive on site

blocks.zh: 類比：餐廳的食材供應商管理
blocks.en: Analogy: a restaurant's ingredient supplier management

blocks.zh: 米其林餐廳不會只看供應商的報價單，他們會親自去農場確認種植方式（現場稽核），要求農藥檢測報告（CoA），並建立長期合作關係（Approved Supplier）。ISO 9001 說「你要管好供應商」，GMP 告訴你「具體怎麼管」。
blocks.en: A Michelin-starred restaurant does not just look at a supplier's price quote. It visits the farm in person to confirm the growing methods (on-site audit), asks for pesticide test reports (CoA) and builds a long-term relationship (Approved Supplier). ISO 9001 says "manage your suppliers well"; GMP tells you "exactly how to manage them".

blocks.zh: 8.4.3 對外部供應商的六類溝通要求
blocks.en: The six categories of communication to external providers in 8.4.3

blocks.zh: 要提供的製程/產品/服務規格
blocks.en: The specifications of the process, product or service to be provided

blocks.zh: 核准事項（產品、方法、設備、放行）
blocks.en: Items requiring approval (products, methods, equipment, release)

blocks.zh: 人員資格能力要求
blocks.en: Competence requirements for personnel

blocks.zh: 與組織的互動界面
blocks.en: The external providers' interactions with the organization

blocks.zh: 組織對供應商績效的監控方式
blocks.en: How the organization will control and monitor the external providers' performance

blocks.zh: 組織或客戶將在供應商場所執行的驗證/確效活動
blocks.en: Verification or validation activities that the organization or its customer intends to carry out at the external provider's premises

blocks.zh: 第 6 點特別重要：客戶到 CDMO 現場執行品質稽核，或 CDMO 到原料供應商執行 Vendor Audit——都在此條款範疇。
blocks.en: Point 6 is especially important: a customer performing a quality audit at the CDMO site, or the CDMO performing a vendor audit at a raw material supplier, both fall within the scope of this clause.

blocks.zh: Production and Service Provision — 生產與服務提供
blocks.en: Production and Service Provision

blocks.zh: 解說：生產控制與藥廠 GMP 的深度對應
blocks.en: Commentary: How Production Control Maps in Depth to Pharmaceutical GMP

blocks.zh: 8.5.1f — 「特殊製程」確效：ISO 9001 的核心概念
blocks.en: 8.5.1f, "special process" validation: a core ISO 9001 concept

blocks.zh: 最重要的條款：當製程結果「無法靠後續監測或量測驗證」時，需要對該製程進行確效（Validation）並定期再確效。
blocks.en: The most important clause: when the output of a process "cannot be verified by subsequent monitoring or measurement", the process must be validated and periodically revalidated.

blocks.zh: 這正是藥廠確效的理論基礎——你無法對每支注射劑做無菌測試（破壞性），所以必須提前確效整個無菌製程：
blocks.en: This is the theoretical basis for pharmaceutical validation. You cannot sterility-test every vial of an injectable (the test is destructive), so the entire aseptic process must be validated in advance:

blocks.zh: 滅菌確效（Sterilization Validation）：高壓蒸汽、乾熱、過濾除菌
blocks.en: Sterilization validation: autoclave (steam), dry heat and sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: 培地灌裝（Media Fill / Process Simulation）：無菌灌裝製程模擬
blocks.en: Media fill (process simulation): simulation of the aseptic filling process

blocks.zh: 清潔確效（Cleaning Validation）：共線生產的殘留交叉污染控制
blocks.en: Cleaning validation: control of residues and cross-contamination in shared-line (multi-product) manufacturing

blocks.zh: 電腦化系統確效（CSV）：無法靠肉眼確認的自動化製程
blocks.en: Computerized system validation (CSV): automated processes that cannot be confirmed by eye

blocks.zh: 類比：烘焙蛋糕 vs. 罐頭殺菌
blocks.en: Analogy: baking a cake vs. canning

blocks.zh: 烘焙蛋糕可以切開確認熟了（後續量測可驗證）。但罐頭殺菌後無法每罐都打開測試內容物還在不在，所以必須事先確效：在特定溫度、壓力、時間組合下，確認所有位置都能達到足夠的致死率（F₀值）。這就是「特殊製程」確效的本質。
blocks.en: A baked cake can be cut open to check that it is done (subsequent measurement can verify it). But after canning sterilization you cannot open every can to test whether the contents are still safe, so the process must be validated in advance: confirming that, under a given combination of temperature, pressure and time, every location reaches a sufficient lethality (F₀ value). This is the essence of "special process" validation.

blocks.zh: 8.5.2 可追溯性（Traceability）在藥廠的意義
blocks.en: What 8.5.2 traceability means in a pharmaceutical plant

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求「需要時」建立唯一識別和追溯。藥廠 GMP 則是強制要求完整的批次追溯：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires unique identification and traceability "where necessary". Pharmaceutical GMP mandates complete batch traceability:

blocks.zh: 批號系統（Batch/Lot Number）
blocks.en: Batch/lot number system

blocks.zh: 原料追溯到 CoA 和供應商
blocks.en: Raw materials traceable to the CoA and supplier

blocks.zh: 生產設備、人員、環境數據
blocks.en: Production equipment, personnel and environmental data

blocks.zh: 發生召回時能快速追溯所有影響批次（Batch Record Review）
blocks.en: In the event of a recall, all affected batches can be traced quickly (batch record review)

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211 要求批次記錄保存至效期後 1 年，或至少 3 年——遠超 ISO 9001 的最低要求。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 requires batch records to be retained for 1 year after the expiration date, or at least 3 years, which far exceeds the minimum ISO 9001 requirement.

blocks.zh: 8.5.5 交貨後活動——藥廠的藥物警戒對應
blocks.en: 8.5.5 Post-delivery activities: the pharmacovigilance equivalent in pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求考量「潛在不良後果、使用壽命、法規要求」。藥廠對應項目：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires consideration of "potential undesired consequences, the lifetime of the products and services, and statutory and regulatory requirements". The pharmaceutical equivalents are:

blocks.zh: 藥物警戒（Pharmacovigilance）：上市後不良反應監測
blocks.en: Pharmacovigilance: post-marketing monitoring of adverse reactions

blocks.zh: Field Safety Corrective Action（FSCA）：召回與安全通知
blocks.en: Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA): recalls and safety notices

blocks.zh: 穩定性計畫（Ongoing Stability）：確認效期內品質
blocks.en: Ongoing stability programme: confirming quality throughout the shelf life

blocks.zh: 年度產品品質審查（APR/PQR）：EU GMP Ch.1 要求
blocks.en: Annual Product Review (APR/PQR): required by EU GMP Ch.1

blocks.zh: 8.5.6 變更控制——藥廠的 Change Control 系統
blocks.en: 8.5.6 Change control: the pharmaceutical Change Control system

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求記錄變更審查結果、授權人及後續行動。藥廠 GMP 更進一步：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires records of the results of change reviews, the persons authorizing the change and any necessary actions. Pharmaceutical GMP goes further:

blocks.zh: 分類（微小/重大/重要 change）
blocks.en: Classification (minor/major/critical change)

blocks.zh: 風險評估
blocks.en: Risk assessment

blocks.zh: 跨部門審查（QA、生產、法規、工程）
blocks.en: Cross-functional review (QA, production, regulatory, engineering)

blocks.zh: 法規申報評估（是否需 Variation/PAS/CBE）
blocks.en: Regulatory filing assessment (whether a Variation/PAS/CBE is needed)

blocks.zh: 有效性確認（Effectiveness Check）
blocks.en: Effectiveness check

blocks.zh: Release of Products & Control of Nonconforming Outputs — 放行與不合格品管控
blocks.en: Release of Products & Control of Nonconforming Outputs

blocks.zh: 解說：放行管控與不合格品——藥廠的嚴格要求
blocks.en: Commentary: Release Control and Nonconforming Outputs, Stricter Requirements in Pharmaceutical Plants

blocks.zh: 8.6 產品放行：QP（Qualified Person）的責任
blocks.en: 8.6 Product release: the responsibility of the QP (Qualified Person)

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求放行前通過計畫性安排，並記錄授權人。藥廠有更嚴格的制度：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires that planned arrangements be completed satisfactorily before release, and that the person authorizing release be recorded. Pharmaceutical plants operate a stricter system:

blocks.zh: EU GMP：每批次必須由 QP（授權人）簽署放行，具法律責任
blocks.en: EU GMP: every batch must be certified and released by a QP (Qualified Person), who carries legal responsibility

blocks.zh: FDA：Quality Unit 負責批次審查和放行（21 CFR 211.192）
blocks.en: FDA: the Quality Unit is responsible for batch review and release (21 CFR 211.192)

blocks.zh: 放行前要求：完整批次記錄審查、偏差評估、OOS 調查結果、穩定性數據
blocks.en: Pre-release requirements: complete batch record review, deviation assessment, OOS investigation results and stability data

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 說「授權人追溯性」——藥廠是 QP 對政府當局的個人法律責任，層級完全不同。
blocks.en: Where ISO 9001 speaks of "traceability to the person authorizing release", in a pharmaceutical plant the QP carries personal legal responsibility to the authorities, which is a completely different level.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的不合格品管理更嚴格
blocks.en: Stricter nonconforming product management in pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: OOS（Out-of-Specification）：需按 FDA OOS 指引進行調查，不能簡單讓步接受
blocks.en: OOS (Out-of-Specification): must be investigated according to the FDA OOS guidance; it cannot simply be accepted by concession

blocks.zh: 重加工（Rework）：需要正式的 Rework Protocol，並重新通過完整的 QC 測試
blocks.en: Rework: requires a formal Rework Protocol, and the material must pass the full set of QC tests again

blocks.zh: 銷毀記錄：不合格品的銷毀需要雙人見證並記錄
blocks.en: Destruction records: destruction of nonconforming product requires two-person witnessing and a record

blocks.zh: 偏差系統：ISO 9001 僅要求文件記錄，藥廠要求偏差調查、根本原因分析（RCA）、CAPA
blocks.en: Deviation system: ISO 9001 only requires documented records, whereas pharmaceutical plants require deviation investigation, root cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA

blocks.zh: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation — 監測、量測、分析與評估
blocks.en: Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

blocks.zh: 解說：績效量測——從 KPI 到患者安全
blocks.en: Commentary: Performance Measurement, from KPIs to Patient Safety

blocks.zh: 類比：飛機的儀表板
blocks.en: Analogy: an aircraft instrument panel

blocks.zh: 飛行員不是靠感覺飛，是靠儀表板：高度計、速度計、燃油量。ISO 9001 的 9.1 就是要求組織建立自己的「品質儀表板」——確定哪些指標是飛行安全的關鍵，並定時讀取和評估。
blocks.en: Pilots do not fly by feel; they fly by instruments: altimeter, airspeed indicator, fuel gauge. Clause 9.1 of ISO 9001 requires the organization to build its own "quality instrument panel": determine which indicators are critical to flight safety, then read and evaluate them regularly.

blocks.zh: 9.1.2 CDMO 的「客戶滿意度」：誰是真正的客戶？
blocks.en: 9.1.2 "Customer satisfaction" for a CDMO: who is the real customer?

blocks.zh: 這是藥廠 CDMO 的獨特挑戰：
blocks.en: This is a unique challenge for a pharmaceutical CDMO:

blocks.zh: 直接客戶：委託方（製藥公司）——他們對交貨期、品質、溝通的滿意度
blocks.en: Direct customer: the sponsor (pharmaceutical company), whose satisfaction with delivery time, quality and communication matters

blocks.zh: 終端客戶（Ultimate Customer）：患者——他們的安全性和療效
blocks.en: Ultimate customer: the patient, whose safety and efficacy are at stake

blocks.zh: 患者不會直接給 CDMO 填問卷，但患者的安全就是 CDMO 品質工作的最終目的。ICH Q10 提倡的Patient-centric quality culture（以患者為中心的品質文化）正是這個理念。
blocks.en: Patients will never fill in a survey for the CDMO, but patient safety is the ultimate purpose of the CDMO's quality work. The patient-centric quality culture promoted by ICH Q10 embodies exactly this idea.

blocks.zh: 監測方法：客戶投訴分析、藥物警戒訊號、市場回收數據——這些間接反映了對患者的影響。
blocks.en: Monitoring methods: analysis of customer complaints, pharmacovigilance signals and market recall data, all of which indirectly reflect the impact on patients.

blocks.zh: 9.1.3 的七個分析輸出——整合到 APR/PQR
blocks.en: The seven analysis outputs of 9.1.3: integrating them into the APR/PQR

blocks.zh: 藥廠的年度產品品質審查（Annual Product Review / Product Quality Review）正是 9.1.3 的實踐：整合全年產品、製程、供應商、偏差、CAPA、穩定性數據，評估 QMS 有效性，識別改善機會。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical Annual Product Review / Product Quality Review is exactly the practical implementation of 9.1.3: it integrates a full year of product, process, supplier, deviation, CAPA and stability data to evaluate the effectiveness of the QMS and identify opportunities for improvement.

blocks.zh: 9.1.1 量測什麼？何時量測？
blocks.en: 9.1.1 What to measure, and when?

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 沒有規定具體量測什麼，只要求組織自行決定。藥廠的典型量測矩陣：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 does not specify what to measure; it only requires the organization to decide for itself. A typical measurement matrix for a pharmaceutical plant:

blocks.zh: Internal Audit — 內部稽核
blocks.en: Internal Audit

blocks.zh: 解說：內部稽核——查廠準備的日常訓練
blocks.en: Commentary: Internal Audit, Everyday Training for Regulatory Inspections

blocks.zh: 稽核計畫的風險導向設計
blocks.en: Risk-based design of the audit programme

blocks.zh: 9.2.2a 要求稽核頻率考量「製程重要性、組織變更、前次稽核結果」——這是風險導向稽核計畫（Risk-based audit programme）的基本邏輯。
blocks.en: 9.2.2a requires the audit frequency to take into account "the importance of the processes concerned, changes affecting the organization, and the results of previous audits". This is the basic logic of a risk-based audit programme.

blocks.zh: 藥廠實務：無菌灌裝、滅菌、OSD 壓錠等高風險製程的稽核頻率高於倉儲、行政部門。新引入製程或設備變更後應安排額外稽核。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical practice: high-risk processes such as aseptic filling, sterilization and OSD tablet compression are audited more frequently than warehousing or administrative departments. Additional audits should be scheduled after new processes are introduced or equipment is changed.

blocks.zh: 客觀性與公正性（Objectivity and Impartiality）
blocks.en: Objectivity and Impartiality

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求稽核員對被稽核區域保持獨立性——稽核員不應稽核自己負責的工作。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires auditors to be independent of the area being audited: auditors should not audit their own work.

blocks.zh: 藥廠實務：通常採用交叉稽核（Cross-audit）——A 線人員稽核 B 線，或由 QA 部門主導，生產人員參與技術面稽核。外部稽核（Third-party audit）提供更高的客觀性。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical practice: cross-audits are common (Line A personnel audit Line B), or QA leads the audit with production staff taking part in the technical aspects. External (third-party) audits provide even greater objectivity.

blocks.zh: 類比：飛機的定期維護檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: scheduled aircraft maintenance checks

blocks.zh: 航空公司不等到飛機出問題才檢查，而是按照飛行小時定期進行 A-check、C-check、D-check。內部稽核就是 QMS 的「定期維護」——不是在出問題後才亡羊補牢，而是系統性地找出問題苗頭。
blocks.en: Airlines do not wait for an aircraft to develop a problem before inspecting it; they carry out A-checks, C-checks and D-checks at set flight-hour intervals. Internal audit is the "scheduled maintenance" of the QMS: not closing the stable door after the horse has bolted, but systematically finding the early signs of problems.

blocks.zh: 內部稽核 = 法規查廠的日常訓練
blocks.en: Internal audit = everyday training for regulatory inspections

blocks.zh: 對藥廠而言，內部稽核有雙重價值：
blocks.en: For a pharmaceutical plant, internal audit has a dual value:

blocks.zh: QMS 維護：找出合規缺口、識別改善機會
blocks.en: QMS maintenance: finding compliance gaps and identifying opportunities for improvement

blocks.zh: 查廠準備（Inspection Readiness）：以 FDA/EMA/衛福部查廠的標準來稽核自己，讓員工熟悉查廠情境，找出文件缺口
blocks.en: Inspection readiness: auditing yourself to the standard of an FDA/EMA/MOHW inspection, familiarizing staff with inspection scenarios and finding documentation gaps

blocks.zh: 優秀的藥廠 QA 部門會把內部稽核報告當作模擬查廠觀察，針對性地在真正查廠前解決問題。
blocks.en: A good pharmaceutical QA department treats internal audit reports as simulated inspection observations and resolves the issues in a targeted way before the real inspection.

blocks.zh: Management Review — 管理審查
blocks.en: Management Review

blocks.zh: 解說：管理審查——高層責任的具體體現
blocks.en: Commentary: Management Review, Top Management Responsibility in Practice

blocks.zh: 管理審查的三個關鍵字
blocks.en: Three key words in management review

blocks.zh: Suitability（適切性）：QMS 是否仍適合組織的目的與背景？（隨著業務規模變化）
blocks.en: Suitability: is the QMS still suited to the organization's purpose and context? (as the business changes in scale)

blocks.zh: Adequacy（充分性）：QMS 的資源和架構是否足夠？（人員、設備、系統）
blocks.en: Adequacy: are the QMS's resources and structure sufficient? (people, equipment, systems)

blocks.zh: Effectiveness（有效性）：QMS 是否真的在運作並達到結果？（不只是有文件，而是有效果）
blocks.en: Effectiveness: is the QMS really operating and delivering results? (not just having documents, but having effect)

blocks.zh: 類比：年度董事會報告
blocks.en: Analogy: the annual board meeting

blocks.zh: 管理審查就像公司的年度董事會：高層主管不看日常細節，而是看整體趨勢——去年達成了哪些目標、有什麼重大問題、明年需要投入什麼資源。9.3.2 的輸入清單就是「品質版董事會議程」。
blocks.en: Management review is like a company's annual board meeting: senior executives do not look at day-to-day detail but at overall trends: which goals were achieved last year, what major problems arose, what resources are needed next year. The input list in 9.3.2 is the "quality version of the board agenda".

blocks.zh: 「前次管理審查的後續行動狀態」——追蹤閉環
blocks.en: "Status of actions from previous management reviews": tracking to closure

blocks.zh: 9.3.2a 要求審查前次決議的執行狀態，這是品質管理的「閉環」原則：做出決定（輸出）→ 執行 → 追蹤結果 → 下次管理審查確認關閉。
blocks.en: 9.3.2a requires a review of the implementation status of the previous review's decisions. This is the "closed loop" principle of quality management: make a decision (output), carry it out, track the result, and confirm closure at the next management review.

blocks.zh: 沒有這一步，管理審查就會淪為「每年開一次的例行報告會」，決議從未真正執行。
blocks.en: Without this step, management review degenerates into an "annual routine reporting meeting" whose decisions are never actually implemented.

blocks.zh: Improvement: General — 改善：一般要求
blocks.en: Improvement: General

blocks.zh: 解說：改善的全光譜
blocks.en: Commentary: The Full Spectrum of Improvement

blocks.zh: 改善的三個層次
blocks.en: Three levels of improvement

blocks.zh: 產品/服務改善：提升配方、工藝、包裝——通常對應技術開發項目
blocks.en: Product/service improvement: improving formulation, process and packaging, usually corresponding to technical development projects

blocks.zh: 問題預防與糾正：這是 10.2 CAPA 的核心
blocks.en: Problem prevention and correction: this is the core of 10.2 CAPA

blocks.zh: QMS 效能提升：流程優化、數位化、培訓計畫改善
blocks.en: QMS performance improvement: process optimization, digitalization and improved training programmes

blocks.zh: NOTE 提到的改善光譜
blocks.en: The improvement spectrum in the NOTE

blocks.zh: 從漸進到突破：矯正（Correction）→ 矯正措施（Corrective Action）→ 持續改善（Continual improvement）→ 突破性變革（Breakthrough change）→ 創新（Innovation）→ 組織重整（Re-organization）
blocks.en: From incremental to breakthrough: correction → corrective action → continual improvement → breakthrough change → innovation → re-organization

blocks.zh: 藥廠的改善活動通常聚焦在前三項，「突破性變革」需要監管申報。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical improvement activities usually focus on the first three; "breakthrough change" requires a regulatory filing.

blocks.zh: Nonconformity and Corrective Action — 不符合事項與矯正措施
blocks.en: Nonconformity and Corrective Action

blocks.zh: 解說：CAPA——FDA/EMA 查廠最關鍵的系統
blocks.en: Commentary: CAPA, the Most Critical System in FDA/EMA Inspections

blocks.zh: 類比：醫生看病
blocks.en: Analogy: a doctor treating a patient

blocks.zh:
Correction：開退燒藥，讓體溫下降（處理症狀）。
Corrective Action：抽血找感染源、開抗生素根治感染（消除根因）。
blocks.en:
Correction: giving a fever reducer to bring the temperature down (treating the symptom).
Corrective Action: drawing blood to find the source of infection and prescribing antibiotics to cure it (eliminating the root cause).

blocks.zh: 只退燒不找病因，下週又會燒。只 Correction 不做 Corrective Action，下次同樣問題還是會發生。
blocks.en: If you only reduce the fever without finding the cause, the fever will return next week. If you only do Correction without Corrective Action, the same problem will recur.

blocks.zh: CAPA 在 FDA/EMA 查廠中的核心地位
blocks.en: The central role of CAPA in FDA/EMA inspections

blocks.zh: 對藥廠而言，CAPA 系統是最受監管機構關注的系統之一：
blocks.en: For pharmaceutical plants, the CAPA system is one of the systems that regulators focus on most:

blocks.zh: FDA Warning Letter 常見缺失：CAPA 根本原因調查不足、有效性確認未執行、CAPA 逾期未關閉
blocks.en: Common FDA Warning Letter deficiencies: inadequate root cause investigation, effectiveness checks not performed, CAPAs overdue and not closed

blocks.zh: EMA GMP 查廠重點：CAPA 是否針對反覆發生的偏差？高層管理是否接收 CAPA 趨勢報告？
blocks.en: EMA GMP inspection focus: does CAPA address recurring deviations? Does senior management receive CAPA trend reports?

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 要求：CAPA 系統是製藥品質系統的四大要素之一
blocks.en: ICH Q10 requirement: the CAPA system is one of the four key elements of the pharmaceutical quality system

blocks.zh: 10.2.1 的六步驟對應藥廠 CAPA 流程
blocks.en: The six steps of 10.2.1 mapped to the pharmaceutical CAPA process

blocks.zh: 反應（10.2.1a）：即時控制——隔離、停線、通知客戶
blocks.en: React (10.2.1a): immediate control: quarantine, stop the line, notify the customer

blocks.zh: 評估根因（10.2.1b）：根本原因分析（RCA）——5 Whys、Fishbone、FMEA
blocks.en: Evaluate root cause (10.2.1b): root cause analysis (RCA): 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA

blocks.zh: 實施行動（10.2.1c）：執行 CAPA——修改 SOP、培訓、設備改善
blocks.en: Implement action (10.2.1c): carry out the CAPA: revise SOPs, training, equipment improvements

blocks.zh: 確認有效性（10.2.1d）：Effectiveness Check——30/60/90天後確認問題未再發
blocks.en: Review effectiveness (10.2.1d): Effectiveness Check: confirm after 30/60/90 days that the problem has not recurred

blocks.zh: 更新風險評估（10.2.1e）：回頭修訂 FMEA 或風險登記冊
blocks.en: Update risk assessment (10.2.1e): go back and revise the FMEA or risk register

blocks.zh: 更新 QMS（10.2.1f）：若需修改文件系統或程序
blocks.en: Update the QMS (10.2.1f): if the documentation system or procedures need to change

blocks.zh: Correction vs. Corrective Action——最重要的區別
blocks.en: Correction vs. Corrective Action: the most important distinction

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的 10.2.1a 是 Correction，10.2.1b-f 是 Corrective Action。兩者都需要，缺一不可。
blocks.en: In ISO 9001, 10.2.1a is Correction and 10.2.1b-f is Corrective Action. Both are needed; neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: Continual Improvement — 持續改善
blocks.en: Continual Improvement

blocks.zh: 解說：持續改善——ISO 9001 的精神核心
blocks.en: Commentary: Continual Improvement, the Heart of ISO 9001

blocks.zh: 「持續」的含義——不只是「改善過一次」
blocks.en: The meaning of "continual": not just "improved once"

blocks.zh: Continual improvement 中的 "continual"（持續的、循環進行的）而非 "continuous"（不間斷的），意思是改善是一個反覆循環的過程，而非一次性活動。
blocks.en: In continual improvement, "continual" (recurring, cyclical) is used rather than "continuous" (uninterrupted), meaning that improvement is a repeating cycle rather than a one-off activity.

blocks.zh: 驅動來源：9.1.3 分析評估結果（數據驅動）+ 9.3.3 管理審查輸出（高層決策）→ 識別改善機會 → 實施改善 → 再次評估。
blocks.en: Drivers: 9.1.3 analysis and evaluation results (data-driven) + 9.3.3 management review outputs (top management decisions) → identify improvement opportunities → implement improvements → evaluate again.

blocks.zh: 類比：PDCA 螺旋
blocks.en: Analogy: the PDCA spiral

blocks.zh: 持續改善不是走一個圈回到原點，而是像螺旋梯——每轉一圈都比上一圈高一層。每個 PDCA 循環結束後，標準提升了，下一個循環從更高的起點開始。
blocks.en: Continual improvement is not going around a circle and returning to the starting point, but climbing a spiral staircase: each turn takes you one level higher than the last. When each PDCA cycle ends, the standard has been raised and the next cycle starts from a higher point.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的持續改善機制
blocks.en: Continual improvement mechanisms in pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: APR/PQR（年度產品品質審查）：系統性識別產品和製程改善機會
blocks.en: APR/PQR (Annual Product Review): systematically identifying opportunities to improve products and processes

blocks.zh: Lean / Six Sigma：製程效率改善（減少浪費、降低變異）
blocks.en: Lean / Six Sigma: improving process efficiency (reducing waste, lowering variability)

blocks.zh: 知識管理（ICH Q10）：累積製程理解，持續縮小設計空間的不確定性
blocks.en: Knowledge management (ICH Q10): accumulating process understanding and continually reducing uncertainty in the design space

blocks.zh: Benchmarking：對標行業最佳實踐，設定改善目標
blocks.en: Benchmarking: comparing against industry best practice to set improvement targets

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 vs. Pharma GMP: Requirements Comparison — 標準要求深度比較
blocks.en: ISO 9001 vs. Pharma GMP: Requirements Comparison

blocks.zh: 理解對照表的用途
blocks.en: Understanding the purpose of the comparison table

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 是品質管理的通用基礎框架——適用於任何行業、任何規模的組織。製藥 GMP 在這個基礎上疊加了行業特有的強制要求，反映藥品對患者安全的特殊責任。理解這兩個層次有助於藥廠人員知道「我們做的，遠超 ISO 9001 要求」。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 is a general foundational framework for quality management, applicable to organizations of any industry and any size. Pharmaceutical GMP layers industry-specific mandatory requirements on top of this foundation, reflecting the special responsibility medicines carry for patient safety. Understanding these two layers helps pharmaceutical staff recognize that "what we do goes far beyond what ISO 9001 requires".

blocks.zh: Key Takeaways — 核心要點總結
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 藥廠人員的核心學習點
blocks.en: Core learning points for pharmaceutical staff

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 是地板，GMP 是天花板
blocks.en: ISO 9001 is the floor; GMP is the ceiling

blocks.zh: 對製藥從業者而言，ISO 9001 的要求在多數情況下是你們已經在做的事的最低版本。理解 ISO 9001 的邏輯框架，有助於：
blocks.en: For pharmaceutical practitioners, the ISO 9001 requirements are in most cases the minimum version of what you are already doing. Understanding the logical framework of ISO 9001 helps you to:

blocks.zh: 向非藥廠人員解釋你們的品質系統
blocks.en: Explain your quality system to people outside the pharmaceutical industry

blocks.zh: 評估新供應商的品質成熟度（他們可能只有 ISO 9001 認證）
blocks.en: Assess the quality maturity of new suppliers (they may hold only ISO 9001 certification)

blocks.zh: 準備 ISO 9001 審查，理解 GMP 的額外要求從何而來
blocks.en: Prepare for an ISO 9001 audit and understand where the additional GMP requirements come from

blocks.zh: 三個「必記」的關鍵概念
blocks.en: Three "must-remember" key concepts

blocks.zh: Review ≠ Verification ≠ Validation：三個不同目的，不能互相取代（8.3.4）
blocks.en: Review ≠ Verification ≠ Validation: three different purposes that cannot substitute for one another (8.3.4)

blocks.zh: Correction ≠ Corrective Action：一個消除症狀，一個消除根因（10.2.1）
blocks.en: Correction ≠ Corrective Action: one eliminates the symptom, the other eliminates the root cause (10.2.1)

blocks.zh: 特殊製程需要確效：因為無法靠後續量測驗證——滅菌、無菌灌裝的法源（8.5.1f）
blocks.en: Special processes need validation: because they cannot be verified by subsequent measurement; this is the basis for sterilization and aseptic filling validation (8.5.1f)

blocks.zh: 給 CDMO Operations Director 的視角
blocks.en: The perspective of a CDMO Operations Director

blocks.zh: Clauses 8–10 描述的整個循環——計畫執行 → 評估績效 → 持續改善——正是營運卓越（Operational Excellence）的 DNA。ISO 9001 提供了框架，GMP 填入了藥廠的具體要求。作為 COO 軌道的領導者，要把這個框架從「合規工具」提升到「競爭優勢」：一個運作良好的 QMS 不只是通過查廠，而是真正減少偏差、提升 OEE、縮短放行週期——這些都直接影響 CDMO 的競爭力和客戶信心。
blocks.en: The whole cycle described in Clauses 8-10 (plan and execute → evaluate performance → improve continually) is the DNA of Operational Excellence. ISO 9001 provides the framework, and GMP fills in the specific requirements of pharmaceutical plants. As a leader on the COO track, you should lift this framework from a "compliance tool" to a "competitive advantage": a well-run QMS does not just pass inspections, it genuinely reduces deviations, improves OEE and shortens release cycle times, all of which directly affect the CDMO's competitiveness and customer confidence.
